## Specific task description

Task instruction: Place the bread loaf with soft surface into the woven shallow breadbasket.

Task description: Put both the small brown bread on the left and golden square bread on the right into the shallow rectangular woven bread basket lying diagonally in front of the image.

Success criteria: Both pieces of bread are in the shallow basket, horizontally near its center and within the basket's support area above the table. Both grippers are open and the bread has been released.

## Execution tips

- Grip flat, thick middle sections on opposite sides of the bread, opening slightly wider locally. Confirm the fingers are on opposite sides before closing to reduce pressing only the top or pushing it over.
- The square piece of bread on the right is near the stand base. Consider approaching from above and setting the gripper opening based on its width and nearby clearance to reduce sideways contact with the stand.
- When crossing the basket rim, keep both the bread bottom and fingertips above it. If the bread must be turned, do so where there is room above the opening to avoid tipping the shallow basket.
- If there is already bread in the basket, use the remaining space near the center to lower the next piece gradually. Release only after it has secure support to reduce squeezing it out of the basket or dropping it unsupported.
